correctness.rationale: With known source word, a noiseless replicated output reveals precisely the output lengths for each maximal constant-symbol input run. For each observed total L the MAP posterior contribution is the maximum product over positive compositions of L, so summing gives U_r and multiplying over independent runs gives P*. The extreme composition lower bound yields a1^(m-c); pairwise outward transfer for nondecreasing ratios proves equality for every strictly positive log-convex law and normalized geometric sharpness. Inward balancing for nonincreasing ratios proves the displayed double series, and a2^2>a1*a3 yields strict improvement for r>=2. Markov-path weighting gives πM^(m-1)1; downstream noise cannot increase Bayes success by data processing. Finite positive-composition max checks were independent corroboration.

value.rationale: An exact full labeled duration-vector recovery probability and universal sharp dwell-law curvature dichotomy is a motivated inference limit for sticky replication channels; it is not a capacity bound or elementary rename of log-convex products. The Markov source formula and noise converse make the sharp benchmark useful.

limitations: Known source word and positive iid common durations are essential; observation is noiseless for the MAP equality.
